## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      9 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 20.04.2026 - 19.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _.oliviaaa_, 15.08.2026, 1/5: "There's a lot of issues on mobile compared to the desktop version. For example, when you select a paragraph and try to delete it instead of holding down the delete button, it doesn't delete. Sometimes even when you hold down the delete button, a letter or two doesn't get deleted. It's generally laggy and without a premium subscription, you can't even upload a single video as the file max is 10mb and most videos are over that. You have to find a site and register to embed the videos instead. Overall greedy platform. Used to be good until it became buggy and you're can't upload a video without the app's premium subscription being shoved down your throat."
            2. _AS-QV_, 13.08.2026, 1/5: "Lot of bugs like emoji selection failures, Formatting text on the phone. Notion used to be the minimalist note taking app with seamless UX. Now, it's like any other tech company. Product is pushing to add more features for the cost of reduced usability to boost internal KPIs. Save Notion or I'm out to Obsidian!"
            3. _narwhalez123_, 04.08.2026, 1/5: "Was a big fan of this app a couple of years ago, i find the organisation so satisfying. I re-downloaded it recently and the lag and ai-centric design has really made it into one of the worst note taking apps i have ever used! You can’t do anything without the screen freezing and it feels like it’s just turned into a generic ai chatbot app with a little bit of organisation on the side (that doesn’t even work most of the time??) it’s so disappointing to see and I hope the creators import an ai-free version for notetakers who actually think for themselves, perhaps the lack of ai will make some of the other features less laggy."
<!--/ir-theme-->
